heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
Division 5—Protected international trade marks—amendment or cessation of protection
Subdivision D—Cessation of protection for nonuse
text: (1) A person may make an application for cessation of protection. (2) However, an application may not be made under subregulation (1) if an action concerning the protected international trade mark is pending in a prescribed court. (3) If subregulation (2) applies, a person may apply to the court for an order directing the Registrar to cease protecting the protected international trade mark.
title: Application for cessation of protection

units.text: (1) A person may make an application for cessation of protection.
(2) However, an application may not be made under subregulation (1) if an action concerning the protected international trade mark is pending in a prescribed court.
